in_sanskrit.name: किन्नेरा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kinnera is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kinnara', which means 'mountain of gold'. In Hindu mythology, Kinnaras are a class of celestial musicians who are half-human and half-bird.

in_hindi.name: किन्नेरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: किन्नराओं के नाम, जिनका अनेक रूप वाले अपराजित सिंहासन पर स्थित रूप वाले गुरू के साथ सह जाते थे। किन्नराओं का अर्थ 'वर्कारत' था, जिसका अर्थ 'सुवर्ण पर्वत' था। अतः नाम 'किन्नेरा' को 'सुवर्ण पर्वत' के समान रखने के लिए प्रकाशित गई है।

in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Kinnera in Tamil is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kinnara', which means 'golden mountain'. In Hindu mythology, Kinnaras are a class of celestial musicians who are half-human and half-bird.

in_marathi.name: Kinnera
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kinnera हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Kinnara’, a mythological creature in Indian mythology, which is half-human and half-bird. Kinnera represents the feminine form of this being, symbolizing strength, grace, and fortune.
